title: Day 35 — FINAL BOSS: LRU + TTL Cache
prompt: The final one: an in-memory cache with LRU eviction and per-key TTL. Two bugs — reads don't refresh recency, and eviction removes the wrong end — plus we want a keys() listing. Time is injected. Walk me through it end to end.

clarifications.answer: A get() on a live key counts as a use — it becomes most-recently-used. That's BUG CACHE-1.
Eviction must remove the LEAST-recently-used entry. The bug pops the most-recent (last=True) instead of last=False.
TTL is anchored to insert time and NOT reset by reads. Expires when now > expiry; valid at exactly expiry.
keys(now) returns non-expired keys in LRU order (least-recently-used first).
The OrderedDict encodes recency by position: the tail is most-recent (move_to_end), the head is least-recent.
now is passed in to put/get/keys, so everything is deterministic.

hints: In an OrderedDict, move_to_end pushes a key to the tail (most recent); popitem(last=False) removes the head (least recent).
BUG CACHE-1: get() must move_to_end(key) after the TTL check. BUG CACHE-2: put() must evict with popitem(last=False).
keys(now): iterate self._data.items() in order (head=LRU), skip entries whose expiry is < now (strictly), and collect the rest.
